maddeler.e:
نستصح (form X)
# نَسْتَصِحُّ (nastaṣiḥḥu) /nas.ta.sˤiħ.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَصَحَّ (istaṣaḥḥa)
# نَسْتَصِحَّ (nastaṣiḥḥa) /nas.ta.sˤiħ.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصَحَّ (istaṣaḥḥa)
# نَسْتَصِحِّ (nastaṣiḥḥi) /nas.ta.sˤiħ.ħi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَصَحَّ (istaṣaḥḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
